note: Curated X post summaries (live API unavailable or unpaid). Follow accounts below for newest posts.

items.title: The Hindu
items.summary: @the_hindu is sharing live updates on the Nepal floods, with the death toll and missing numbers still climbing and a warning that Bhotekoshi water levels rose again Sunday morning while tunnel rescues go on.

items.title: The Kathmandu Post
items.summary: Families have been arriving in Pokhara to look through photos of the 102 bodies recovered after the Bhotekoshi flood, with over a thousand relatives already there from Gorkha, Tanahun, Dhading and Nawalparasi East. @kathmandupost reports a help desk on site offering free support with filing and transport.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal shared a list of people injured in the Rasuwa Bhotekoshi and Trishuli floods who are currently being treated in Kathmandu hospitals or have already been discharged.

items.title: Embassy of India Beijing
items.summary: After the floods and mudslides in Tibet, local authorities have set up two 24-hour English hotlines for families seeking information on missing foreign nationals: 0086-891-6817165 or 0086-183-0802-6705. @EOIBeijing

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal has posted the latest update on search, rescue and relief work for the Bhotekoshi flood, with details as of 9am on 14 Bhadra 2083.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal shared details of the men rescued today, 13 Bhadra 2083.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal posted a list of foreign citizens rescued today, August 29, 2026.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: From @MoFANepal: In the Bhote Koshi flood, 626 bodies have been recovered so far, with around 2400 people still unaccounted for. Over 4450 have been rescued, including more than 187 foreign nationals, and the search continues.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal shared details on the Kathmandu hospitals treating people injured in the disaster and brought there for care, along with @moha_nepal.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: @MoFANepal says flash floods hit the Bhote Koshi River area on 26 August, with 538 bodies recovered so far and 511 people still missing out of 632 from 33 countries. Search and rescue is ongoing, and families can call their emergency room at +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228.

items.title: The Kathmandu Post
items.summary: If you're searching for family after the floods, @kathmandupost notes that bodies from Rasuwa and Nuwakot are appearing far downstream, with morgues in Chitwan and Pokhara under pressure and temporary centres set up for handling them.

items.title: The Kathmandu Post
items.summary: In Nuwakot, some flooded villages are still waiting on relief while searches continue for missing relatives and homes buried after the Bhotekoshi surge, notes @kathmandupost.

items.title: MoFA Nepal
items.summary: If your family was caught in the Bhote Koshi flash flood in Rasuwa, Nepal’s Emergency Control Room can help foreign nationals by phone or WhatsApp at +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 (7am–10pm), or by email at emergency@mofa.gov.np. @MoFANepal

items.title: NDTV
items.summary: @ndtv shared a ground report from Rasuwa showing the debris and washed-out markets along the Bhotekoshi–Trishuli after the glacier and debris flow. For the latest numbers, check with NDRRMA.

items.title: The Rising Nepal
items.summary: @therising_np says their reporters were on the ground from Dhunge Bazaar to Trishuli and Devighat, where people had only minutes to get out after the alert around 8:55am, and journalists are there with security forces during the rescue.

items.title: MEA India
items.summary: Families with relatives in Nepal can reach @MEAIndia’s control room for the floods at +91-11-23088718, +91-11-23088719, WhatsApp +91-9968291988, or situationroom@mea.gov.in.

items.title: NDRRMA Nepal
items.summary: @NDRRMA_Nepal is sharing rescue and coordination updates for the Bhotekoshi and Rasuwa flash flood on their rescue portal and the SETU platform.

items.title: Nepal Police HQ
items.summary: @NepalPoliceHQ has official lists of people found, missing, or with unidentified remains from the flood areas in their database.

items.title: Embassy of India Kathmandu
items.summary: The Indian Embassy in Kathmandu (@IndiainNepal) is working with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals caught in the flash floods around Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi. Reach out to the MEA control room or the embassy if your family needs help.

items.title: Parshuram Kaphle
items.summary: A Nepali journalist posted on the Rasuwa and Bhote Koshi flash flood through @journoprk, pointing out gaps in early warnings that came from across the northern border after the flooding hit.
